content.title: 'Euphoria' Season 3 Release Schedule: When Do New Episodes Come Out?
content.text: NEED TO KNOW Euphoria is back for season 3, more than four years after season 2 endedThere will be eight episodes in the new installmentSeries creator Sam Levinson calls season 3 "expansive" Euphoria is finally back for season 3. More than four years after season 2 ended, the Emmy-winning series from writer, director and creator Sam Levinson returns to follow Rue (Zendaya) and her former classmates after a five-year time jump. "Five years felt like a natural place because if they’d gone to college they’d be out of college at that time,” Levinson said in December 2025, per Variety. "We basically pick up Rue [Zendaya] south of the border in Mexico, in debt to Laurie [Kelly], trying to come up with some very innovative ways to pay it off." Viewers will also catch up with other characters, including Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Nate (Jacob Elordi), as well as Jules (Hunter Schafer), Maddy (Alexa Demie) and Lexi (Maude Apatow), among others. Here's everything to know about the Euphoria season 3 release schedule. When does Euphoria season 3 premiere? Sydney Sweeney in 'Euphoria' season 3. Patrick Wymore/HBO Euphoria season 3 debuts on April 12. The series was renewed for a third season in February 2022, the same month season 2 concluded. In July 2024, it was announced that the next installment would start production in January 2025. “I am thrilled that we are ready to begin production on Euphoria in January,” Francesca Orsi, executive vice president of HBO Programming and Head of HBO Drama Series and Films, said in a statement. “We could not be happier with our creative partnership with [creator] Sam [Levinson] and this incredible cast,” Orsi continued. "We look forward to bringing this new season of Euphoria to life for the fans.” Production on season 3 eventually started in February 2025. How many episodes are in Euphoria season 3? Jacob Elordi in 'Euphoria' season 3. Patrick Wymore/HBO Like the previous two seasons, there will be eight episodes in Euphoria season 3. "I wanted to create a mosaic of these outsider characters and people who were on the fringes, who were dealing with addiction and insecurities. These were characters that I felt were rich and I could really mine, and that’s how I built it," Levinson told The Hollywood Reporter in March 2026 about season 3. "It’s a pretty expansive season of television and it really allowed us to dig deeper into these characters," he added. What is the Euphoria season 3 episode release schedule? Hunter Schafer in 'Euphoria' season 3. Patrick Wymore/HBO Following Euphoria's season 3 premiere on April 12, new episodes will air weekly. Here's the release schedule for season 3: April 12: Episode 1April 19: Episode 2April 26: Episode 3May 3: Episode 4May 10: Episode 5May 17: Episode 6May 24: Episode 7May 31: Episode 8 What time do new episodes of Euphoria come out? Colman Domingo and Zendaya in 'Euphoria' season 3. Patrick Wymore/HBO New episodes of Euphoria air at 9 p.m. ET. During an April 2026 appearance on The Drew Barrymore Show, Zendaya teased "closure is coming" when asked about the new season. “Euphoria, it cracked my heart open. Rue taught me so much about life," said the actress, who has won two Emmys for her role. "I mean, that crew also has seen me grow up. I owe so much to that show.” “Rue taught me so much about empathy and about redemption. She taught me a lot, and I'm very grateful for all of it," Zendaya continued. Related Stories Where can I watch Euphoria? Alexa Demie in 'Euphoria' season 3. Jeremy Colegrove/HBO Euphoria airs on HBO and is available to stream on HBO Max.
